ollama.parameters: Ollama defaults (no seed, no temperature set)

arms.v1: v1 context (walk order, first 24k chars, no line numbers) and v1 prompt
arms.v2: line-numbered retrieved context (BM25 + symbol RRF) and v2 prompt
arms.v2-strict: v2 replies after strict verification (no extra model call)

metrics.citation_validity: valid citations / all citations (file indexed, lines exist)
metrics.groundedness: valid citations whose lines were in the context shown / all citations
metrics.gold_hit_rate: share of answers with a valid citation that overlaps a gold span
metrics.gold_hit_rate_narrow: gold_hit_rate, counting only citations of at most 30 lines
metrics.term_recall: mean share of the question's key terms that appear in the answer
metrics.cited_answers: share of answers with at least one citation
metrics.mean: the mean of the per-run values
metrics.pooled: the value over all runs' answers pooled, which ci95 is built around
metrics.ci95: percentile bootstrap over questions (per-question values pooled over runs), 10,000 resamples, seed 0
